map.用最小二乘法拟合 y = ax + b，输出斜率、截距与预测值。: Fits y = ax + b by least squares and reports the slope, intercept and prediction.
map.📖 查看「线性回归拟合使用指南」: 📖 View the "Linear Regression Fit User Guide"
map.斜率 a = (nΣxy − ΣxΣy) / (nΣx² − (Σx)²)；截距: Slope a = (nΣxy − ΣxΣy) / (nΣx² − (Σx)²); intercept b = (Σy − aΣx) / n; prediction ŷ = a·x + b
map.用最小二乘法对 5 对 (x, y) 样本拟合直线 y = ax + b：斜率: The line y = ax + b is fitted to 5 pairs of (x, y) by least squares: the slope a comes from the ratio of the covariance of x and y to the variance of x, and the intercept b places the line through the sample means (x̄, ȳ). Substituting any x yields the prediction ŷ, for trend analysis and data modelling.
map.输入成对数据，可指定任意 x 预测 y。: Enter paired data and specify any x to predict y.
map.📚 深度解析：统计功效与效应: 📚 In-depth: Statistical Power and Effect Size
map.实验设计把握度规划。: Planning the assurance level of an experiment.
map.功效低易漏检真实效应。: Low power risks missing a real effect.
map.α=0.05、n=30/组、d=0.5：功效≈0.48，偏低（易漏检）；增至 n: With α=0.05, n=30 per group and d=0.5, power ≈0.48: too low, since real effects are easily missed; raising n to 64 per group gives power ≈0.80, meeting the usual target.
map.d=0.8、n=30：功效≈0.86，已足。: With d=0.8 and n=30, power ≈0.86, which is sufficient.
map.真实效应存在时正确拒绝原假设的概率（1−β）；通常要求 ≥0.8。: The probability of correctly rejecting the null hypothesis when a real effect exists (1−β); at least 0.8 is normally required.
map.α、n、d、功效四者关系？: How do α, n, d and power relate?
map.给定三者可求第四者；设计时常固定 α 与目标功效，反推所需 n 或 detect: Any three determine the fourth; a design usually fixes α and the target power, then solves for the required n or the detectable effect d.
